**ARE YOU READY TO SHAPE HOW GANNI COMES TO LIFE ACROSS EVERY PHYSICAL CUSTOMER TOUCHPOINT? WE ARE LOOKING FOR A COMMERCIAL, CREATIVE, AND HANDS-ON LEADER TO DRIVE OUR GLOBAL VISUAL MERCHANDISING STRATEGY.

****Your Mission & Responsibilities Ahead Of You

**As Head of Global Visual Merchandising, you will play a key role in bringing the GANNI brand to life across our global retail network. Acting as the bridge between Creative and Commercial, you will translate seasonal creative direction into visual merchandising concepts that strengthen the customer experience, support commercial performance, and ensure a consistent brand representation across all physical customer touchpoints.

Working closely with Creative, Retail, Wholesale, Buying, Marketing, and Product teams, you will develop global visual merchandising standards while supporting markets in delivering best-in-class execution. This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution - project management, stakeholder collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**Responsibilities ahead of you:

**Global Visual Merchandising Strategy

• Develop and continuously evolve GANNI's global visual merchandising strategy across all physical customer touchpoints.

• Translate seasonal creative direction into commercially effective visual merchandising concepts and execution.

• Act as the bridge between Creative and Commercial to ensure visual merchandising aligns with both brand identity and commercial priorities.

• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure consistent execution across the business.

Brand Representation & Customer Experience

• Develop global VM guidelines, seasonal playbooks, execution decks, and visual standards.

• Ensure consistent brand representation across Retail stores, Wholesale, Department Stores, Concessions, Showrooms, Pop-ups, and Events.

• Lead the visual merchandising direction for seasonal launches, campaigns, collaborations, and key commercial moments.

• Ensure VM standards are executed consistently across all markets while allowing relevant local adaptations.

• Create engaging customer experiences that support both the brand and commercial objectives.

Commercial Performance

• Partner closely with Retail, Wholesale, Buying, Merchandising, and Marketing to maximise commercial performance through visual merchandising.

• Use retail KPIs and commercial insights to continuously improve customer experience and sales performance.

• Support product sell-through through effective product presentation, storytelling, customer flow, and merchandising principles.

• Monitor store feedback and customer behaviour to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Global VM Community & Capability

• Support and develop GANNI's global network of field Visual Merchandising resources and Retail VM Ambassadors.

• Develop training programmes, tools, and best practices that strengthen VM capabilities across markets.

• Coach regional VM resources and retail teams to ensure consistent execution.

• Foster collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning across the global VM community.

**Showrooms & Physical Brand Experience

**

• Lead the visual merchandising strategy across global showrooms during seasonal sell-in periods.

• Ensure collections are presented in a commercially effective, inspiring, and customer-focused way.

Cross-Functional Projects

• Lead global VM projects from concept through implementation.

• Support new store openings, refurbishments, showroom projects, retail concepts, and pop-up activations.

• Collaborate closely with Creative, Marketing, Retail, Wholesale, Buying, Merchandising, Product Development, and Retail Operations.

• Continuously identify opportunities to simplify VM processes and improve ways of working across markets.

**Must Have Requirements

**

• 5–8 years of experience within Visual Merchandising in fashion, lifestyle, or premium retail.

• Experience developing and implementing visual merchandising strategies across multiple markets and sales channels.

• Strong understanding of how visual merchandising influences customer behaviour, supports commercial performance, and creates a consistent customer experience.

• Experience creating global VM guidelines, seasonal toolkits, showroom concepts, and visual standards.

• Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work across Creative and Commercial functions.

• Excellent project management and organisational skills.

• Strong communication and presentation skills.

• Fluent in English.

• Willingness to travel internationally.

**THE GANNI WAY

**We're looking for someone who combines creativity with commercial understanding and enjoys working across functions to bring ideas to life.

You are a hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys turning creative concepts into clear, practical solutions. You build strong relationships, communicate with confidence, and naturally collaborate across teams and markets.

You have a curious mindset, continuously look for opportunities to improve, and understand how strong visual merchandising can strengthen both the customer experience and business performance.

We are looking for a true GANNI ambassador - someone who shares our values of Openness (ready to evolve, honest not perfect), Optimism (you never stand still, just dance!), Authenticity (you march at your own beat!), Accountability (no excuses, you make an impact) & Responsibility (make small changes, see big differences).

The GANNI culture is based on a learning and results-driven mentality, where everyone is united by a common purpose of (hack)the fashion system!

GANNI is a state of mind - more than a way of dressing and we love to change the usual practice in everything we do. We are confident and capable of anything! So prepare yourself to be comfortable with the uncomfortable and hacking the system together with our amazing VM team!

**WHAT ELSE?

**

• Based in Copenhagen.

• Global role with regular international travel.

• Opportunity to shape the future of GANNI's global visual merchandising strategy and execution across Retail, Wholesale, Showrooms, and other physical customer touchpoints.

• Lead and develop a global VM team while working closely with colleagues across Creative and Commercial functions.

**DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

**At GANNI, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds - regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, racial identity, religious belief, disability status, or personal expression.

We believe that diversity drives creativity and innovation, and we are dedicated to building a team that reflects the world around us.

To support unbiased hiring, we kindly ask you not to include your photo, age, or marital status in your CV - we’re only interested in why you’re a great fit for the role.

**BE BOLD AND JOIN OUR GANNI COMMUNITY!

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel motivated to join our team and become a part of the GANNI community.

We will be interviewing candidates continuously and kindly ask you to send your application and CV as soon as possible. Please use the “Apply for position” button.

**MORE GANNI GOODIES

**You will be working out of our unique GANNI house located in the beautiful City Center of Copenhagen on top of the Bremerholm flagship store. Besides our amazing and colorful new office facilities, we are also proud of our inhouse GANNI kitchen that offers healthy and sustainable food cooked by our passionate in-house chef.

Intro

Karo Healthcare, a dynamic and growing personal-care retail company, is all about making smart choices for everyday healthcare. With a wide-ranging portfolio across seven categories, including medical products, we own and sell over 80 brands in about 90 countries. Our portfolio includes such brands as E45, Pevaryl, Lamisil, Nutravita, Decubal, and many others. Our core belief in empowering people to make intelligent health decisions drives our growth strategy, blending organic expansion and M&A.

Join us at Karo Healthcare on our exciting journey. We're currently looking for a Key Account Manager, Pharmacy for our office in Copenhagen.

What’s in it for you?

This is a high-impact commercial role where you will take real ownership of key pharmacy partnerships, influence how our brands win in-store, and work closely with Sales, Marketing, E-commerce and external partners. You’ll join a fast-moving international business where ideas turn into action quickly and where there is plenty of room to shape the role, grow your commercial expertise and make a visible impact.

What you’ll be doing

• Develop and execute customer strategies for key pharmacy accounts together with the Sales Director, Brand Managers and E-commerce KAM.

• Plan, submit, execute and evaluate trade campaigns together with internal teams and external agencies.

• Build, strengthen and grow strategic relationships with existing pharmacy partners.

• Lead annual customer planning, commercial negotiations and account development.

• Identify commercial opportunities that drive sustainable growth, profitability and sell-out performance.

• Ensure customer campaigns, pricing, assortment, product information and commercial activities are implemented accurately and on time.

• Act as a commercial sparring partner to Brand Managers to create best-in-class brand visibility and in-store execution.

• Manage key wholesaler processes, including maintenance of pricing, assortment and customer information.

• Take ownership of the CRM system supporting pharmacy sales representatives and help ensure effective commercial execution of key pharmacy accounts

• Use customer, market and commercial insights to continuously improve performance, service levels and ways of working.

Requirements

• Master’s degree, professional bachelor’s degree or equivalent education in a relevant field.

• Solid experience from a commercial, sales or key account management environment.

• Being structured and managing customer processes diligently and promptly

• Experience working with B2C customers, ideally within FMCG, consumer healthcare, pharmaceuticals, retail or another fast-moving industry.

• Experience with the Danish pharmacy market or consumer healthcare sector is an advantage.

• Strong commercial mindset with experience in customer negotiations, account planning and business development.

• Excellent relationship management and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Entrepreneurial and hands-on mindset with a strong “go-do” attitude.

• Comfortable taking ownership, working independently and building structure in a dynamic environment.

• Commercially and financially minded, with the ability to balance customer opportunities with profitable growth.

• Able to maintain a strong overview while managing multiple priorities in a changing international business.

Benefits

• Opportunity to create, grow, and encourage

• Apart from a competitive salary pack, there are lots of growth opportunities to meet your personal ambitions

• Flexible schedule and life work balance

• Responsibility for exciting and challenging projects that have a direct, visible impact on our customers and the industry

• Very positive work environment in a young, international, and motivated team

• Start-up spirit while being a part of the large international organization with strong values

Karo Healthcare has a Diverse & Inclusive environment. We are looking for qualified candidates irrespective of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, religion, national origin, disability or age.

Our purpose is to offer smart choices for everyday healthcare and we are passionately working towards realising our vision of Karo becoming a pan-European leader in everyday healthcare. With this ambitious growth strategy, we are constantly scouting for new talents to join our existing dynamic and high-paced Karo team. Embracing diverse perspectives and backgrounds is a part of our identity, and an equal representation of women and men in management positions. If you want to work for a dynamic high-growth company that is flat, non-bureaucratic, and that empowers colleagues to make their own decisions through the trust placed in their capabilities and alignment to our strategic goals and vision – check out our current vacancies.

About MITS Industries

MITS Industries is establishing an R&D and design site in Copenhagen focused on advanced RF systems, signal intelligence, aerospace technologies, and mission-critical product development.

The site will build core engineering capabilities in RF and microwave hardware, antenna systems, RF testing and characterization, rugged mechanical integration, and the industrialization of complex radio-electronic systems.

The Copenhagen team will work closely with strategic partners and engineering teams across Europe, playing a leading role in the development, validation, and industrialization of advanced technologies for defense, aerospace, and other demanding applications.

One of the initial focus areas will be the development of an advanced aerospace signal intelligence product platform. The work will cover RF and system architecture, antenna system design, signal acquisition, embedded control, laboratory validation, mechanical integration, integration with the satellite platform, and preparation for production and field deployment.

The ambition is to build a strong technical design site capable of taking complex RF products, modules, and platforms from architecture and detailed design through prototyping, testing, validation, industrialization, and deployment.

About the role

MITS Industries is looking for a Senior RF / Microwave Hardware Engineer to join the core Copenhagen R&D team and help build the site’s RF and microwave design capability.

You will design and develop RF and microwave hardware and subsystems, including receiver front ends, amplification, filtering, mixers and local-oscillator circuitry, RF signal routing, and PCB- and module-level implementation. The work covers RF performance analysis and design trade-offs, circuit architecture, schematic design, component selection, circuit and electromagnetic simulation, RF PCB implementation and layout, prototyping, debugging, and performance validation.

You will work closely with system architects, antenna systems engineers, SDR and signal processing engineers, RF test and characterization engineers, mechanical design engineers, and partner engineering teams. The role requires deep RF and microwave design expertise, technical ownership, and hands-on implementation experience, taking designs from concept through prototyping and validation to documented, manufacturable RF modules and subsystems.

Key responsibilities

• Translate system requirements into RF hardware architecture, specifications, performance budgets, and design trade-offs.

• Design RF and microwave circuits, modules, and signal-acquisition paths, including amplification, filtering, switching, mixing, frequency synthesis, gain control, and supporting bias, power, and control circuitry.

• Perform RF performance analysis covering sensitivity, selectivity, gain, noise figure, dynamic range, linearity, stability, spurious responses, and interference resilience.

• Create RF schematics, select components, and own RF PCB implementation, including laminate and material selection, stack-up definition, and layout, with controlled-impedance routing, transmission lines, grounding, shielding, isolation, and high-frequency interconnects.

• Perform circuit and electromagnetic simulations, optimize designs, and correlate simulated performance with laboratory measurements.

• Lead prototypes bring-up, tuning, debugging, and design verification in collaboration with RF test and characterization engineers.

• Integrate RF hardware with antenna systems, data-conversion interfaces, mechanical assemblies, and platform interfaces.

• Contribute to design verification, EMC/EMI assessment, environmental qualification, reliability evaluation, and system-level validation.

• Prepare hardware specifications, design documentation, BOMs, analysis reports, design-review materials, test inputs, and production-release documentation.

• Own technical decisions related to component and supplier selection, manufacturability, testability, lifecycle risks, and design-risk mitigation.

• Collaborate with system, antenna, signal-processing, test, mechanical, manufacturing, and partner engineering teams.

Required qualifications and experience

• Master’s degree in electrical or electronic engineering, RF/microwave engineering, applied physics, or a related field. A PhD is an advantage.

• 7+ years of professional experience in RF and microwave hardware design.

• Strong hands-on experience developing RF circuits, multilayer PCBs, modules, and subsystems from schematic design and simulation through layout, bring-up, tuning, and validation.

• Experience with receiver architectures and RF signal paths, including low-noise and gain stages, filters, switches, mixers, oscillators, PLL-based frequency synthesis, and supporting bias, power, and control circuitry.

• Strong understanding of RF system budgeting, chain analysis, and frequency planning, including gain, noise figure, sensitivity, selectivity, dynamic range, P1dB, IP3, phase noise, stability, spurious responses, isolation, and impedance matching.

• Practical experience with RF PCB implementation, including laminate and material selection, stack-up definition, controlled-impedance routing, transmission lines, grounding, shielding, isolation, and high-frequency interconnects.

• Hands-on experience with schematic capture and RF PCB layout using an industry standard ECAD tool such as Altium Designer, Cadence Allegro/OrCAD, or equivalent.

• Proficiency with one or more RF circuit and electromagnetic simulation tools, such as Keysight ADS, Cadence AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, or CST Studio Suite.

• Hands-on experience with RF measurement equipment, including vector network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and oscilloscopes.

• Demonstrated ability to bring up, tune, troubleshoot, and validate RF hardware and correlate measured results with simulations.

• Experience taking RF hardware through prototype manufacturing, assembly, design verification, environmental requirements and qualification, and production release.

Nice to have

• Experience with signal-intelligence, direction-finding, spectrum-monitoring, or radio-surveillance systems.

• Experience with SDR-based radio architecture.

• Experience designing wideband, high-dynamic-range, low-noise receiver systems.

• Experience with coherent or multichannel RF systems, including channel matching, phase stability, and synchronization.

• Experience developing aerospace, mission-critical, or ruggedized electronic systems.

• Experience developing RF and microwave hardware operating at frequencies up to and beyond 18GHz.

Success in the first 6 months

• Take technical ownership of one or more RF modules or subsystem areas.

• Establish the initial architecture, design approach, and development plan for the assigned RF scope.

• Deliver reviewed schematics, simulations, layout inputs, and supporting design documentation.

• Bring up and validate initial hardware prototypes, with clear correlation between expected and measured performance.

• Identify key RF, implementation, and integration risks and define practical mitigation actions.

• Establish effective technical interfaces with system, antenna, signal-processing, test, mechanical, manufacturing, and partner engineering teams.

At Claimlane, we're looking for a problem solving focused Product Designer. You'll spend most of your time talking directly to customers to understand how they work through their problems today, then shape and validate the right solution with the team and finally design the solution. This is a problem-solving role first, design second.

You will enjoy this role if you are curious, work fast, and appreciate the opportunity to have a huge impact on our product.

About Claimlane

Claimlane is a rapidly growing B2B SaaS scale-up. We fix complex claims and returns processes for top retailers and brands like Matas, Coolshop, Black Diamond, and Tonies.

We're looking for A-players who want to make a difference and grow with the business. We value a strong positive attitude, a high sense of ownership, and long-term thinking. Attitude beats talent.

We want to build a billion-dollar business, and part of that is building a team with billion-dollar potential.

The Role

You will spend the majority of your time solving problems, not producing designs & screens. That process starts with talking directly to customers and the team, mapping out how customers work through a problem today, and building a clear, written definition of how to build a better solution for them. Only once the problem is deeply understood do you shape a solution, and even then, you validate it with real customer feedback before treating it as done and ready to be designed.

You will work in close collaboration with product and engineering from day one, and you will rapidly take on more independence as you build context. Within your first month, you will be solving smaller problems on your own. Within three months, you will independently own problem definition and design for solutions end to end.

This is a junior-to-mid-level role built for fast growth. You do not need years of product design experience, but you do need to be an exceptional problem solver who is comfortable getting close to customers, curious about how things actually work, and eager to grow into a stronger product designer along the way.

Key Responsibilities

• Talk directly to customers and the team to deeply understand problems and map them out.

• Turn ambiguous problems into clear, written problem definitions before shaping a solution.

• Design and ship solutions for working closely with engineering & customer facing team.

• Run customer and user-testing conversations and turn findings into concrete product improvements or new solutions.

• Gather feedback on shipped work and use it to shape the next iteration.

• Take on progressively larger and more ambiguous problems as you build context and trust with product and engineering.

Requirements

• Exceptional problem solver who structures ambiguous situations into a clear definition before jumping to a solution.

• Comfortable talking directly to customers and mapping out their workflows to understand a problem from the ground up.

• Strong visual and UX sense, able to turn a well-understood problem into clean, modern, and readable designs.

• Clear communicator who can explain design decisions and trade-offs in handoffs to engineering, including edge cases.

• Quick learner who picks up new tools, product domains, and feedback fast.

• Balances speed and quality, knowing when good enough is the right call to keep the team moving.

• Low-ego, high-energy collaborator who works transparently and takes feedback well.

Bonus Points If You Have Experience With

• Running customer interviews or user research independently.

• Working directly with engineers on technical constraints and trade-offs.

• Working in B2B SaaS or scale-up environment.

• Figma and modern design tooling.

Location and Compensation

Our office is in Nørrebro, Copenhagen, and this is an in-office role. Our team enjoys coming in, and everyone has the flexibility to shape their workday around their lifestyle.

Our compensation package is competitive, and we offer an attractive warrants and stock program.

If you're a positive, ambitious person who wants to build real problem-solving muscle as a product designer, Claimlane will be the right vehicle for you, and we'd love to welcome you. Don't waste time, apply now! 🚀

Hiring Process

• Intro Call: A 15 to 30 minute conversation to see if we click.

• Culture Interview: A 1 to 2 hour deep dive into values, mindset, and team fit.

• Problem-Solving Case: A 1 to 3 hour session working through a real customer problem, from understanding it to proposing a solution. No polished mockups required. We're flexible if you prefer another format, so feel free to shine in your own way.

• Team Meetup: A 30 minute chance to say hi to the team.

• References: A final check before we make things official.

Apply on LinkedIn or send your resume to asl@claimlane.com. We review candidates on an ongoing basis. Sending a 60 second video introducing yourself will move you to the top of the stack, though it's not required.

Offshore/Onshore L2 Rope Access Painter / QC – Denmark Offshore Sector

Join Altrad on long-term offshore fabric maintenance and protective coating projects within the Danish Offshore Energy sector. We are looking for experienced IRATA Level 2 Rope Access Painters with additional QC experience and recognised trade qualifications to support offshore maintenance campaigns across Denmark. We need Danish Candidates or Candidates that currently live in Denmark

This is an excellent opportunity to secure ongoing offshore work on a stable 2/3 rotation while working with established offshore teams in demanding offshore environments.

The Role

As an L2 Rope Access Painter / QC, you will carry out offshore rope access painting, surface preparation, inspection support, and coating quality control activities on offshore installations. You will work within multi-discipline offshore maintenance teams ensuring all coating works are completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with offshore specifications and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

• Carry out offshore rope access painting and coating activities

• Perform surface preparation including mechanical preparation, grinding, power tooling, and cleaning

• Apply protective coatings using brush, roller, and spray application methods

• Conduct coating inspections and basic QC reporting activities

• Measure and record DFT readings and coating compliance checks

• Support fabric maintenance and corrosion protection programmes offshore

• Ensure all work complies with client specifications and offshore quality standards

• Follow offshore HSE procedures and permit-to-work systems

• Participate in toolbox talks and offshore safety meetings

• Maintain rope access and painting equipment in safe working condition

• Complete daily reports, QC documentation, and inspection records where required

Requirements

Essential Experience

• Previous offshore rope access painting experience within Oil & Gas

• IRATA Level 2 certification with offshore experience

• Experience with industrial coatings and offshore maintenance projects

• Experience carrying out basic paint QC inspections and reporting

• Strong understanding of offshore safety standards and working practices

• Ability to work effectively within offshore teams

• Good communication skills

Required Certifications

Candidates must hold valid certification including:

• IRATA Level 2 (L2)

• BOSIET / FOET with CA-EBS

• Valid Offshore Medical Certificate

• Painter Trade Certificate / Quality Trade Qualification

• Basic Paint QC qualification or coating inspection experience preferred

Rotation & Package

• Offshore/Onshore rotation: 2 weeks on / 3 weeks off

• Competitive offshore rates

• Paid travel, accommodation, and meals

• Long-term offshore project opportunities

• Ongoing work within the Danish offshore sector

Location

• Offshore Denmark

• Danish Offshore Energy installations

To apply, please send your CV and certifications via the application link below.

Altrad Services A/S employs more than 600 employees, the majority offshore, and has offices in Middelfart, Esbjerg, Vissenbjerg, Kalundborg and Hillerød. Are you an experienced reward professional who enjoys turning complex problems into practical solutions delivering value to Pandora? Do you want to shape how performance and reward are applied across Pandora’s Global Office while enabling leaders and HR teams to make confident, consistent decisions? If so, this could be the opportunity for you!

We are looking for an exceptional Manager, Performance & Reward Global Office to join our Performance & Reward CoE at Pandora’s Global Headquarters in Copenhagen.

As the Performance & Reward partner for the Global Office, you will act as the primary connection between the business and our global team. You will play a key role in shaping and governing reward solutions, bringing business needs into global design and equipping HR Business Partners with the guidance and tools they need to make high-quality decisions.

This role offers the opportunity to combine strategic reward expertise with close business partnering in a truly global environment. You will provide expert guidance and oversight across key Performance & Reward matters, while helping to strengthen capabilities throughout Pandora’s People Function.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Strategic Performance & Reward Advisory: Advise HR Directors and HR Business Partners on complex, high-impact Performance & Reward matters, ensuring that global reward principles are applied effectively within the Global Office context.

• 
Capability Building: Translate Performance & Reward frameworks and principles into practical guidance, tools and learning that enable the People Function to manage standard matters with greater confidence and independence.

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

About the job

Are you at the start of your career and ready to help shape Saxo's balance sheet analytics, risk frameworks, and treasury decision-making through data, modelling and quantitative analysis?

We are looking for a talented and motivated Quantitative Risk Analyst to join our Market & Treasury Risk team within Risk Strategy & Treasury. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of treasury, risk management, quantitative modelling, and strategic decision-making.

Our team plays a central role in shaping Saxo's earnings profile and balance sheet risks, including liquidity risk, interest rate risk, FX risk and capital risk. We develop and maintain the analytical frameworks, models and methodologies that support balance sheet optimisation, risk management and senior management decision-making across the organisation.

As part of the team, you will contribute to the development of quantitative models, risk metrics as well as analytical tools used to assess earnings, funding, liquidity and market risks. You will work closely with colleagues across Treasury, Finance, Risk, Trading and Technology, gaining broad exposure to the management of a modern international bank.

This role is particularly well suited to professionals in the earlier stages of their career looking to build deep expertise in treasury, risk management and quantitative analysis within an international banking environment.

Responsibilities

•

jobs.description:
Do you want to investigate the resilience of critical raw material supply chains supporting low-carbon and digital technologies? Join us as a PhD student at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, University of Southern Denmark.

The Department of Green Technology at the University of Southern Denmark invites applications for a three-year PhD position in data-driven critical raw material supply chain resilience.

The position will be based at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, Department of Green Technology, Faculty of Engineering, at the SDU Odense campus. The expected starting date is 15 February 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

 

Project Overview

The deployment of low-carbon technologies, electrification and digital infrastructure is increasing global demand for critical raw materials. At the same time, the production and processing of many of these materials are geographically concentrated and exposed to geopolitical, economic, environmental and logistical disruptions.

Understanding how technology development affects material demand, in-use stocks, end-of-life flows and global supply dependencies is therefore important for assessing and strengthening the resilience of critical raw material supply chains.

The PhD position is jointly funded through research projects on critical raw material supply chains and material requirements for Denmark’s climate-neutral transition. The project will be embedded in an interdisciplinary research environment combining environmental systems analysis, supply-chain research and data science.

 

PhD Topic Description

The PhD project will develop modular and data-driven approaches for analysing critical raw material demand, supply-chain dependencies and resilience.

A central methodological contribution will be the development of transparent, reusable and reproducible computational modules for dynamic material flow analysis. The modules will support the integration of technology deployment scenarios, material intensities, product lifetimes, stocks and flows, end-of-life management, recycling, production, trade, facility and ownership data.

The developed approaches will be applied to selected technology systems, including Denmark’s wind-energy infrastructure and the rapidly expanding infrastructure supporting data centres and AI computing. These cases will be analysed within a common methodological framework to examine how infrastructure expansion and technological change influence demand for critical and scarce materials, in-use stocks, future waste flows, recycling potential and global supply-chain dependencies.

The project may also investigate overlapping material requirements and competition for materials across low-carbon and digital technologies. Particular attention may be given to supply concentration, host–by-product dependencies, trade and ownership structures, supply bottlenecks, cascading risks and potential resilience strategies.

Depending on the candidate’s academic background and the specific research questions, the project may include network analysis, geospatial analysis, scenario modelling, uncertainty analysis, machine learning and other AI-supported approaches.

The candidate will build on selected existing models, datasets and research activities in the group and further develop scientifically robust and reusable methods that improve transparency, comparability and reproducibility in material-system research.

The exact research focus and detailed PhD plan will be developed jointly with the successful candidate, taking into account the project objectives, academic background and research interests.

In addition to a PhD dissertation and high-quality scientific publications, the project is expected to produce reusable modelling methods, documented datasets and reproducible computational workflows.

 

PhD Position and Research Environment

As a PhD student, you will conduct independent research under the supervision of an interdisciplinary team, contribute to high-quality scientific publications and participate actively in a collaborative research environment.

You will join SDU Life Cycle Engineering, where research covers industrial ecology, material flow analysis, life cycle assessment, circular economy, resource systems and sustainability transitions.

The project connects expertise in engineering, data science, mathematics, business, supply-chain research and geological resources. The wider research environment includes competences in material flow analysis, critical raw material systems, data mining, network analysis, supply-chain science, finance, investment, ownership structures, geological resources and technology systems.

The position provides opportunities for collaboration across SDU faculties and with external research partners. It may also include participation in international conferences, research visits and collaboration with relevant industrial and public-sector stakeholders.

The PhD programme follows the Danish PhD framework and includes coursework, participation in active research environments, dissemination activities, and teaching or other knowledge-dissemination duties.

 

What We Expect

We are looking for a highly motivated, independent and collaborative candidate with a strong interest in critical raw materials, quantitative modelling, data-driven research and sustainability.

Applicants must hold a relevant master’s degree or equivalent by the time of enrolment. Relevant academic backgrounds may include engineering, industrial ecology, sustainability science, resource management, data science, computer science, applied mathematics, operations research, supply-chain management, geoinformatics, mining or geological sciences, or another relevant natural science or quantitative discipline.

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

• 
A solid academic foundation in quantitative analysis, system modelling, data science or related methods. 

• 
Experience with programming and data analysis, preferably using Python or a similar programming language. 

• 
Experience with data handling, including data cleaning, transformation, integration and exploratory analysis. 

• 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 

• 
The ability to work independently and collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment. 

• 
Good written and spoken English. 

• 
A strong interest in sustainability, critical raw materials and supply-chain resilience. 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage:

• 
Material flow analysis, industrial ecology or material systems modelling. 

• 
Network, supply-chain or geospatial analysis. 

• 
Scientific computing and reproducible research workflows. 

• 
Statistics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, optimisation, uncertainty or scenario analysis. 

• 
International trade, production facility or corporate ownership data. 

• 
Critical raw materials, wind energy, digital infrastructure or data centres. 

Applicants are not expected to possess expertise in all these areas. Prior experience with material flow analysis is an advantage but is not a requirement. Relevant training will be provided according to the candidate’s background and the needs of the project.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

The application must be submitted in English through the SDU online recruitment system.

Assessment of applicants will be based on the submitted application material. The application must include:

• 
Curriculum Vitae. 

• 
A motivated application describing the applicant’s research interests, relevant qualifications and motivation for applying. 

• 
Documentation of academic qualifications, including bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates and complete transcripts of grades. 

• 
Official English translations of documents not issued in English or Danish. 

• 
Two letters of recommendation. 

• 
A list of publications and up to two examples of relevant publications, if available. 

• 
The completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

• 
The completed TEK form for calculation of grade-point average. Find the form at the Faculty website.

• 
Official documentation describing the grading system of the awarding university, if the degree was not obtained in Denmark. 

• 
Examples of relevant thesis work, software, code repositories or other research outputs, where available. 

• 
Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

For administrative questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our email support.

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step. The place of employment is in Odense, Denmark and preferred starting date is February 15, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

 

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology. The research environment conducts interdisciplinary research on the global and systemic interactions between materials, technologies, energy, the environment and society.

The Department of Green Technology is located in Odense, the main campus of the University of Southern Denmark. Odense offers an international research environment and an open Scandinavian working culture.

 

Further Information

Further information about the scientific content of the position is available from:

Wu Chen
Associate Professor
Department of Green Technology
SDU Life Cycle Engineering
University of Southern Denmark
Email: wuc@igt.sdu.dk
